title: Day 7: an AI made squats build a city #shorts
description:
Every squat builds your city.

Squat City is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Keep your iPhone on your chest or in a front pocket and squat. Each rep drops one block on today's building. Lower slowly (about 2 seconds) for a solid block; rush it and the block wobbles and the building leans a little. Your daily reps set the height, and in a month your street has a skyline.

Squat City - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 8 tomorrow.

#squats #homeworkout #fitness #citybuilder #indiegame
